hypotheses.statement: R21 reported ACC and GYRO rates reproduce bit-exactly from (N-1)/duration on the reported n and duration.
hypotheses.falsifier: Recomputation differs beyond an ULP-scaled tolerance from the reported rates.

hypotheses.statement: Reported gravity_residual_mean_abs equals abs(mean(mag)-g0) evaluated on the rounded mean, not mean(abs(norm-g0)).
hypotheses.falsifier: Raw norms show mean(abs(norm-g0)) materially different from the reported value, or the reported value does not match abs(mean-g0).

hypotheses.statement: abs(mean-g0) is a strict lower bound of mean(abs(norm-g0)) on distributions consistent with the reported mean/SD (Jensen gap strictly positive).
hypotheses.falsifier: Existence of a distribution consistent with reported mean/SD whose gap is <= 0.

hypotheses.statement: Magnitude-only aggregates cannot identify device orientation or axis covariance (SO(3)-invariance).
hypotheses.falsifier: A demonstrated recovery of orientation or axis covariance from magnitude statistics alone.

hypotheses.statement: Zero gaps_gt_5x_median does not imply zero packet loss.
hypotheses.falsifier: A proof that the strict > 5x-median rule detects every loss pattern of up to 4 consecutive events.

binding.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 self-implementation verified against official NIST test vectors
